label: PHASE_R_FINAL_CLASSIFICATION_V1
note: Phase N (architecture decision) pending Phase L (domain adaptation) results; N filled as conditional.

failure_topology.description: 360p proxy resolution renders diver as ~5-15% of frame height — below reliable detection threshold for COCO-trained YOLOv8n
evidence: Phase H: 78% of takeoff landmark frames undetectable by F1
Phase J: SAM2 tiny immediate collapse in 5/6 dives (tracking fails without visible diver signal)

failure_topology.description: YOLOv8n trained on COCO general person class; diving pool context and aerial diver scale distribution are out-of-distribution
evidence: F1 center recall: 9/18 (50%) INTERNAL_EVAL — bounding box IoU near-zero despite center proximity; detection boxes systematically undersized
Phase L pending — domain adaptation feasibility TBD

failure_topology.description: Track selection maximizes confidence-sum with no spatial/semantic constraint — bystanders on pool deck outcompete aerial diver
evidence: Phase H H1 analysis: confidence-sum selector picks bystander in known-failure cases
Phase I: motion-coherent selector fails at 360p because diver displacement (~14% frame height) insufficient to distinguish from bystanders
Phase I: flight-arc selector fails because diver arc too small to segment reliably at 360p

failure_topology.description: SAM2 video mask tracking collapses at frame 1 in 5/6 dives tested with tiny checkpoint; likely caused by low-resolution diver signal
evidence: Phase J: dives 311, 2541, 2387, 2169 → IMMEDIATE_COLLAPSE (area=0 one frame after takeoff seed)
Phase J: dive 133 → SUCCESS (only case, likely favorable background/scale)

primary_limiting_factor_rationale: 360p proxy resolution is the root cause: DOMAIN_GAP, ACQUISITION_FAILURE, and TRACKING_COLLAPSE are all downstream consequences. At original resolution (1080p/4K), diver occupies significantly more pixels, COCO recall improves, track selection is easier (more distinctive motion), and SAM2 tracking likely avoids immediate collapse. All other failure modes remain contingent on resolution.

Q1_original_resolution.question: Does original resolution materially affect temporal landmark detection?
Q1_original_resolution.answer: YES — SCALE_FAILURE is the primary root cause. 360p proxies are insufficient.

Q2_track_selection.question: Does track selection affect performance?
Q2_track_selection.answer: YES — structural defect (confidence-sum, no spatial constraint) causes wrong-person selection. SECONDARY to detection failure (78% frames undetectable regardless of selection).

Q3_tracking.question: Does tracking (video mask) affect performance?
Q3_tracking.answer: YES — SAM2 tiny collapses in 5/6 tested dives at 360p. Tracking is unreliable at this resolution. base_plus comparison pending.

Q4_domain_adaptation.question: Does domain adaptation affect performance?
Q4_domain_adaptation.answer: PENDING — Phase L results required. If fine-tuning viable at 360p, detection recall may improve from 8.3% IoU50.

Q5_scene_geometry.question: Does scene geometry affect temporal landmark detection?
Q5_scene_geometry.answer: MARGINALLY — 13/14 DEVELOPMENT dives use fixed camera (consistent board geometry). Board Y median=0.40 and water Y median=0.57 provide spatial priors, but cannot compensate for zero detection.

Q6_primary_factor.question: What is the primary limiting factor?
Q6_primary_factor.answer: SCALE: 360p proxy resolution is the root constraint.

Q8_video_mask_justified.question: Is video mask tracking justified?
Q8_video_mask_justified.answer: NO at 360p. SAM2 tiny IMMEDIATE_COLLAPSE in 5/6 dives (16.7% success). SAM2 base_plus replicates tiny collapse on same test cases (2387: COLLAPSE; 133: SUCCESS identical to tiny). Larger model capacity does not overcome the 360p resolution limit. Video mask tracking requires: (a) human oracle seed, (b) >360p resolution.

Q9_architecture.question: What architecture is recommended?
Q9_architecture.answer: CONDITIONAL: If Phase L (domain adaptation) NOT_VIABLE → PERCEPTION_STILL_INSUFFICIENT. If Phase L VIABLE → DETECTION_PLUS_LIGHTWEIGHT_TRACKING (with fine-tuned detector). Original resolution required for production.

J2_base_plus.notes: matches tiny outcomes on same dives

J_summary.finding: Model size does not determine tracking success at 360p; resolution is the binding constraint
